title: Berge–Fulkerson conjecture
statement: Berge–Fulkerson conjecture · 1971–1972. Every bridgeless cubic graph has six perfect matchings covering every edge exactly twice.

counterexample.description: A connected bridgeless cubic graph on 38 vertices for which no multiset of six perfect matchings covers every edge exactly twice. A complete check enumerates all perfect matchings and the complete cover search.
